verdict.rationale: UCP references AP2 payment mandates as "cryptographically signed payment authorizations that are mathematically tied to the specific state of the cart" and verifiable credentials, plus short-lived (60-minute) JWT checkout tokens and Token-tier gating for complete_checkout — gesturing at scoped, non-raw-card credentials, but this describes protocol/session tokens for API access, not a user-issued payment instrument with explicit amount limits, expiry, and merchant restrictions handed to the agent. Missing for 10: concrete documentation of a user-facing scoped payment credential (spending caps, expiry dates, merchant allow-lists) rather than just agent-identity/session auth tokens, and no independent/hands-on evidence of this credential-issuance flow in practice.
